document.title: Planning criteria and cross-border coordination of frequencies for land mobile systems in the range 29.7 - 470 MHz
document.history_as_printed: RECOMMENDATION T/R 25-08 OF 15 JANUARY 1990 ... REVISED IN VIENNA 1999, IN UTRECHT 2005, IN BRUSSELS 2008 AND IN HELSINKI 2016, AMENDED 28 SEPTEMBER 2018 AND LATEST AMENDED 6 JUNE 2025 (p3)
document.read_method: pages rendered to PNG with macOS PDFKit (poppler not installed) and text extracted with PDFKit; values on pp 6, 10, 12 checked visually against rendered pages

values.section: Annex 1, A1.2.3 Indicative coordination thresholds for analogue or digital land mobile systems
values.reference_bandwidth: 25 kHz ("within a reference bandwidth of 25 kHz")
values.other_bandwidth_rule: Page 6-7: for channel spacing > 25 kHz, if spectral power distribution is uniform within the channel: BC = 10 x log10 (channel spacing / 25 kHz) dB, added to the threshold. For all other spectral power distributions, threshold applies within every 25 kHz bandwidth within the channel spacing.
values.time_note: Footnote 2: "In certain situations, the 1% time curves should be used for digital systems, e.g. to better protect analogue systems."
values.value_as_printed: 0 dB(µV/m) for frequencies between 29.7 and 47 MHz
values.doubt: Band edges are shared between adjacent ranges (e.g. 47 MHz appears in two ranges); the document does not say which value applies exactly at an edge. Unit printed 'dB(µV/m)' without space here, 'dB (µV/m)' in the other four lines (typographic only).

values.section: Annex 3, Table 1: Trigger values for partial overlap between narrowband system and wideband systems at a height of 10 m above ground
values.freq_range_as_printed: within the 410-430 MHz and 450-470 MHz frequency bands (Annex 3 title)
values.other_bandwidth_rule: Table 1 Note 2: if a channel bandwidth other than 25 kHz is used, add 10 x Log10 (channel bandwidth/25 kHz). Note 3: for narrowband systems using preferential frequencies and bandwidth > 25 kHz (e.g. 50, 100, 150, 200 kHz), thresholds apply within every 25 kHz bandwidth within the channel spacing.
values.interference_case: partial overlap of narrowband (<=25 kHz, preferential channels) system on one side and system with channel > 1 MHz on the other side (FDD); not full overlap (ECC Report 276 does not cover full overlap, p9)
values.height_correction: p10: 'For practical purposes, an antenna height correction factor of 10 dB from 10 m to 3 m height may be used.' Other examples: Okumura-Hatta 15.6 dB, ITU-R P.1546 10.3 dB, HCM 9 dB.
values.row: System up to 25 kHz using preferential frequency
values.value_as_printed: 20 dBμV/m/25 kHz@40 km beyond the borderline
values.doubt: Also stated in prose on p9: 'field strength threshold of 20 dB μV/m at 10 m height in 25 kHz at a distance inside the neighbouring country: Preferential Regime a) at 40 km distance and Preferential Regime b) at 50 km distance'. Table cell says 'beyond the borderline' while Note says '@ stands for at a distance inside the neighbouring country'; read as same meaning. Co-channel vs. adjacent not stated explicitly; context is partial frequency overlap.

propagation.prescribed_model: None explicitly prescribed for computing the thresholds. Only prediction parameters are stated: 50% locations, 10% time (A1.2.3; Table 1 Note 1; Table 2 Note 1), with footnote 2 (p6) allowing 1% time curves for digital systems in certain situations.
propagation.p1546: ITU-R Recommendation P.1546-6 (08/2019) is cited as reference [8] (p18) and on p10 only as an example of the 10 m to 3 m height correction (10.3 dB).
propagation.hcm: HCM Agreement [7] cited for propagation details and procedures (considering f, p3) and as a basis for agreements (recommends 1); HCM gives 9 dB height correction (p10).
propagation.height_correction: p10: 10 dB from 10 m to 3 m 'may be used' for practical purposes; examples Okumura-Hatta [6] 15.6 dB, P.1546 10.3 dB, HCM 9 dB.
propagation.bandwidth_correction: A1: BC = 10 x log10(channel spacing / 25 kHz) dB (uniform PSD only); Annex 3: 10 x Log10(channel bandwidth/25 kHz); Annex 4: 10 x Log10(channel bandwidth/5 MHz).
propagation.divergence: recommends 6 (p4): administrations may diverge from the technical parameters, propagation models and procedures subject to bilateral/multilateral agreements. Introduction (p2): existing agreements with other levels remain relevant.

notes: Document covers 29.7-470 MHz only; no values above 470 MHz.
Annex 2 (p8, Figure 1) gives band plans only, no field strengths. Annex 5 (pp13-17) gives PCI/PN code sets; FIN is 'Type country 1' (pp13, 15).
Annex 3 prose (p9) restates the preferential regimes: 20 dB μV/m at 10 m height in 25 kHz at 40 km (regime a) or 50 km (regime b) inside the neighbouring country.
A4 prose (p11) values are identical to Table 2 (p12); recorded once per Table 2 cell.
Only non-AAS base stations are covered (considering n, p3).
Code sharing in Annex 5 is triggered by exceeding the Annex 4 Table 2 trigger level (p16).
